title: Existing application human-facing audit
description: A populated project that uses the same project state and 30-stage workflow as ordinary projects. Its sources are actual files from this repository and its finished product is a real repository artifact.

userEnteredData.requestedOutput: A concise audit of the existing application showing whether the human-facing project workflow is present and inspectable.
constraints: Do not turn appendices into permanent checklist walls
Keep the test project separate from the application
Expose generated prompts, outputs, evidence and history

objective.exactUserObjective: Audit the existing Closed-Loop Reliability application as a real project. Produce one human-readable audit artifact that verifies the one-app constraint, compact human-facing project UI, inspectable project work/history, 30-stage workflow preservation, contextual appendix behavior, and a genuine populated test project.

requirements.requirement: The repository exposes one application entry point and the test project is data inside that application, not another application.
requirements.observableSatisfactionCondition: One index.html application entry and test project loaded into ordinary project state.
requirements.failureCondition: A second app or special parallel test application exists.

requirements.requirement: The normal project interface is compact and human-facing rather than a developer or agent console.
requirements.observableSatisfactionCondition: Project summary, current action, compact controls, progressive disclosure and human labels are present.
requirements.failureCondition: Primary screens are dominated by oversized controls or implementation bookkeeping.

requirements.requirement: A populated test project exposes user data, sources, requirements, generated prompts/instructions, outputs, runs, evidence, defects, corrections, release data and history.
requirements.observableSatisfactionCondition: Each category is inspectable through the same project interface.
requirements.failureCondition: Substantive project work is hidden or represented only by status summaries.

requirements.requirement: Stages 01 through 30 remain available as workflow semantics and stage-specific records/actions.
requirements.observableSatisfactionCondition: All 30 stage records exist and the stage workflow remains operable.
requirements.failureCondition: Any required stage is deleted or replaced only by decorative content.

requirements.requirement: Appendices A-F operate contextually as fresh-context, blocker, change/invalidation, release, new-project and output-receipt capabilities rather than a permanent checklist wall.
requirements.observableSatisfactionCondition: Cross-cutting records appear where relevant and appendix navigation does not dominate normal UI.
requirements.failureCondition: Appendix semantics are deleted or shown only as repetitive global checklists.

tests.procedure: Inspect repository entry points and project-loading state.
tests.expectedResult: One application; test project uses ordinary project state.

tests.procedure: Inspect rendered control dimensions, hierarchy and project navigation.
tests.expectedResult: Compact mobile controls and human project hierarchy.

tests.procedure: Open the populated project and inspect each substantive work category.
tests.expectedResult: All required project information is visible on demand.

tests.procedure: Count and inspect stage records and stage navigation.
Inspect fresh-run, blocker, change, release, new-project and output-receipt behavior.

mutations.violationMode: Hide project history and show only a completion badge.
Render all controls as large full-width buttons.
Render Appendix A-F as permanent checklist pages.

productionInstruction.objective: Inspect the existing application and produce the audit artifact from observed repository/application evidence.
procedure: Inspect the existing application entry point and runtime components.
Inspect the project UI and the populated test project.
Verify each mandatory requirement using its assigned test.
Preserve violations and unknowns rather than converting them to success.
Write the audit artifact with the objective, verified findings, exercised defect and release result.
productionInstruction.completionCriteria: All five mandatory requirements are SATISFIED with evidence and the finished artifact identity is verified.

generatedPrompts.title: Production instruction
generatedPrompts.prompt: Using only the authorized application sources and controlling requirements, inspect the existing application. Verify REQ-001 through REQ-005. Produce the requested audit artifact. Record UNKNOWN where evidence is unavailable and do not infer acceptance from absence of a detected defect.

generatedPrompts.title: Independent execution prompt
generatedPrompts.prompt: In a fresh execution context, inspect the frozen candidate and produce the audit independently. Do not inspect another run's output or reviewer feedback. Preserve the complete output separately.

generatedPrompts.title: Independent verification prompt
generatedPrompts.prompt: Verify the assigned run against every active requirement. Return SATISFIED, VIOLATED, or UNDETERMINED with exact evidence. Do not allow the generator to be its sole verifier.

generatedPrompts.title: Adversarial review prompt
generatedPrompts.prompt: Attempt to disprove the finished audit. Search for hidden project work, missing stages, oversized or machine-facing UI, deleted appendix semantics, false test-project claims, stale evidence and unsupported release conclusions.

output.summary: The initial audit omitted the requirement that complete project history remain inspectable.
Corrected audit includes complete project-history inspection.
Unchanged confirmation reproduced the corrected requirement determinations.

generatedOutputs.output: Ten independently stored audit drafts. Each omitted complete project-history inspection and was retained as failed evidence.
REQ-003 = VIOLATED in all ten runs; DEFECT-001 opened.
Ten corrected independent audits; REQ-001 through REQ-005 = SATISFIED.
Ten unchanged confirmation executions; all mandatory determinations remained SATISFIED.

defects.observedFailure: The initial production instruction asked for visible project data but did not explicitly require complete retained project history, so all ten audits omitted that verification.
defects.earliestDefectiveLayerEvidence: REQ-003 required complete inspectability; the first instruction omitted project-history inspection.
defects.correctionRequired: Add explicit complete-history inspection to the production instruction and rerun the full ten-execution iteration.

regressions.failureFixture: Audit output without a complete-history inspection finding.

changes.exactChange: Added explicit complete project-history inspection to the production instruction.
